title: Mbiru Dzakakwirira dzeMadutu Anofefeterwa Nemhepo
intro: Fungidzira nzanga yakabudirira ine simba guru uye hunyanzvi husina muganho mukuvaka. Yakagara pakati pemadutu makuru akakombama, nharaunda iyi yakagadzira zviratidzo zvikuru zvakasvika pakakwirira. Asi kuzvikudza kwakadzika midzi, uye kudanwa kwekudzokera kunamatwa kwaAllah chete kwakagamuchirwa nekusatenderwa. Zvakatevera zvinoramba zviri yambiro yakaendeswa kumhepo pachayo.
clues: Taiva rudzi rune simba rakauya mushure mevanhu vaNuh, vakakomborerwa nehurefu nesimba guru.
Takavaka shongwe refu nematombo ekurangarira panzvimbo dzose dzakakwirira tichingoitira mitambo chete uye kudada.
Takazvirumbidza, tichiti ndiani ane simba guru kupfuura isu, uye takaita hutsinye tisina tsitsi.
Takaramba mutumwa wedu Hud paakatidana kuti tinamate Allah ega, tichimuti haana simba uye murevi wenhema.
Takaseka yambiro yacho ndokumukurudzira kuti atipe chirango chaakatityisidzira nacho kana akataura chokwadi.
Takaparadzwa nemhepo ine simba, isina chinhu kwehusiku hunomwe nemazuva masere, takasiyiwa takawira pasi semiti yemichindwe isina chinhu.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Akaramba Muporofita Hud uye akazvirumbidza nesimba rake guru
Vakaronga kuuraya Muporofita Yusuf nekuda kwegodo
Akakumbira ngamera hadzi sechiratidzo ndokuicheka makumbo
trial.answer: Akaramba Muporofita Hud uye akazvirumbidza nesimba rake guru

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Mvura yakanaya pamusoro payo nematombo evhu rakabikwa
Vakaparadzwa nekudengenyeka kwenyika kukuru kwakavabata mudzimba dzavo
Yakaparadzwa nemhepo ine simba yechando kwehusiku hunomwe nemazuva masere
outcome.answer: Yakaparadzwa nemhepo ine simba yechando kwehusiku hunomwe nemazuva masere

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
